title_cyr: Каде си тргнало абре бај Постоле
title_latin: Kade si trgnalo abre baj Postole
title_en: Where Have You Set Off To, Hey Uncle Postol
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Note says it commemorates voivoda Apostol Petkov of Enidze Vardar. 'Постоле' is the vocative of Postol, short for Apostol. 'први шпиони' translated as 'first-rate spies' is my reading.

words_to_learn.en: uncle, respectful address for an older man
